plugins.name: xpp
plugins.description: X++ development for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. Skills teach Claude to author AOT objects (tables, classes, forms, EDTs, enums, label files) and pick the right F&O form UX pattern; the bundled MCP server reads and writes via the official Microsoft.Dynamics.AX.Metadata APIs. Local-only, runs on a D365 dev VM.
